title: API database password typo
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the API component, the wrong password problem, and the deploy as the trigger.
root_cause: The API container failed to authenticate to PostgreSQL due to an incorrect database password introduced by the recent deploy of api 2.3.2, causing health‑check failures and 500 errors.
truth: api 2.3.2 was deployed with a typo in the DATABASE_PASSWORD environment variable, so the application cannot authenticate to PostgreSQL.
